blinding_guess.why: In rmw_create_subscription the failure-cleanup path undoes graph_cache.associate_reader(...) with graph_cache.dissociate_writer(info->subscription_gid_, ...) (rmw_fastrtps_cpp/src/rmw_subscription.cpp:104 vs 114; same in rmw_fastrtps_dynamic_cpp:106 vs 116), so a reader GID is dissociated as a writer and the reader stays in the graph cache. Separately, rmw_wait unconditionally clears every guard condition's trigger value after each wait (rmw_fastrtps_shared_cpp/src/rmw_wait.cpp:215-224), which can drop a trigger for a guard condition waited on from more than one wait set; I cannot tell whether that is the intended contract.

notes: 'rmw_fastrtps' is the repository; the snapshot holds three ROS 2 packages, rmw_fastrtps_cpp, rmw_fastrtps_dynamic_cpp and rmw_fastrtps_shared_cpp, all <version>6.3.0</version> (package.xml:5 in each). The seven api symbols are defined with identical collapsed signatures in rmw_fastrtps_cpp and rmw_fastrtps_dynamic_cpp (dynamic name lines: rmw_guard_condition.cpp:26, rmw_subscription.cpp:63 and :197, rmw_wait_set.cpp:26, rmw_take.cpp:38, rmw_trigger_guard_condition.cpp:25, rmw_wait.cpp:24); each forwards to rmw_fastrtps_shared_cpp::__rmw_* (declared in rmw_fastrtps_shared_cpp/include/rmw_fastrtps_shared_cpp/rmw_common.hpp). Provenance cites rmw_fastrtps_cpp. Declarations are the definition text from the return-type line through the closing parenthesis with whitespace runs collapsed to one space (hence '( const' where the parameter list starts on a new line). All ports are C API functions: no .msg/.srv/.action/.idl definition, so msg_type, units, rate and definition_id are null. frame is 'none' for handle/condition/wait functions; null for rmw_create_subscription and rmw_take_with_info because the message type is supplied at run time through type support (void * ros_message). QoS is null throughout: not applicable to the six non-subscription functions; for rmw_create_subscription the profile is the caller's qos_policies argument (must be non-null, rmw_subscription.cpp:74, so there is no API default), adapted by rmw_dds_common::qos_profile_get_best_available_for_topic_subscription from discovered publishers' profiles (rmw_subscription.cpp:76-82), and applied onto a DataReaderQos first loaded from an XML profile keyed by topic name when one exists (rmw_fastrtps_cpp/src/subscription.cpp:264-281), so no value is statically determined. resource:node_notify_guard_condition does not appear in the snapshot (see provenance). references is empty because every packet element is on the provides side. exclusive is empty: grep for 'exclusive'/'ownership' finds only LICENSE text and comments; no exclusive device or command-interface claims. Other observations: rmw_create_wait_set ignores max_conditions ((void)max_conditions, rmw_fastrtps_shared_cpp/src/rmw_wait_set.cpp:40); rmw_trigger_guard_condition sets a Fast DDS GuardCondition trigger value to true (rmw_fastrtps_shared_cpp/src/rmw_trigger_guard_condition.cpp:40).
